items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I never saw my grandfather, although I know all about him now. His name was Benjamin.

ctx.x: My paternal grandparents... I never saw my grandfather, although I know all about him now. His name was Benjamin. And my paternal grandmother's name was Adelaide.
Did they live in the Islands?

items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I had forgotten I had done a record with him, "The World Is Waiting For the Sunrise." ... This was the same place where we did Benny Goodman's records... Benny Goodman on the front line by himself.

ctx.x: You were telling me about the performance with Jay McShann that you mentioned last week.

Yes. I mentioned last week that we were to play on the 3rd of June, but it's since been cancelled because the school didn't think it would be fair to have him compete against Benny Goodman and Ella Fitzgerald and Sarah Vaughan on the same day -- and I think they're right. So most likely they will try to reschedule it at a later date.
